rows.grounds: Accusative singular qualifier describing the object obtained; agrees with santānikaṃ.
Accusative singular object of labdhvā; denotes a rite or observance connected with lineage/continuity in this context.
Absolutive expressing prior action leading to the result stated by iṣṭadam.
Compound indicating purpose: pitṛ (ancestors) + deva (gods) + artha (purpose).
Compound qualifier of santānikaṃ: iṣṭa (desired) + da (giving); indicates the rite yields desired results.
